requests.name: act_pour_milk_to_line
requests.why: 육아_24 4칸(30.93~36.43초 '그러니 우유는 하루 500ml, 작은 생수 한 병만큼만 주고 고기 반찬을 늘려 주세요') 왼쪽. 우유를 컵의 선까지만 따르고 딱 멈춘 뒤, 옆에 둔 작은 생수병과 높이가 같다는 걸 보여 준다(체감 단위). 색인 전수 확인 — 따르는 클립은 act_pour_ors_cup(호박색 수액을 파우치에서 작은 컵에)뿐이고, 우유 클립은 act_push_away_milk(잔을 거절)·act_test_milk_wrist(젖병 온도)·act_mix_formula_bottle(분유 타기)이라 '양을 정해 따르기'가 없다. 범용으로 — 우유 양 제한·하루 우유량·음료 계량·주스 줄이기·수유량 편에 쓴다. 손과 사물만(아기 없음), 숫자·눈금 글자 없음, 엑스레이 화풍 고정.

requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. Only two translucent glass hands, a blank milk carton, a tall clear cup with one engraved ring and a small blank water bottle are ever in frame — no face, no head, no body, and nothing else enters the frame. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame a steady stream of soft milky white milk pours from the carton into the cup while the camera drops fast to table level and pushes in on the cup. 1.5-3s: the milk climbs the cup and the instant its surface touches the engraved ring the carton snaps upright and the stream cuts off clean, the ring glowing soft warm amber for a moment. 3-4.5s: the carton is set down and slides out of frame, and the other hand pushes the small water bottle up against the cup so their heights line up, the milk level matching the bottle. 4.5-6s: the camera stops hard on the cup and the bottle side by side, the milk surface settling exactly on the ring and holding still until the very last frame. Style lock: every structure stays rendered as the same translucent pale cyan glass with softly glowing edges in the dark slate blue-grey void from the first frame to the very last; the scene never turns opaque, matte, mint green, beige, illustrated or photorealistic. The hands stay translucent glass with the finger bones visible inside throughout. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame; the cup carries only the single plain ring, never any digits. Low ambient synth hum with a soft pouring gurgle that stops short, no music, no dialogue.
